title: "Foam glider"

{{< include _model.qmd >}}

A 300mm span glider constructed from 5mm foam sheets, optimizing planform and trim state with `AeroBuildup`. Assumes negligible fuselage mass/drag and uses NACA4405/0005 airfoils to represent the 5mm foam.
